lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Ga2Zn2O8 (reduced formula YGaZnO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral ZnO4 and GaO4 environments, with Zn–O and Ga–O neighbor distances of about 1.92–2.09 Å, while Y shows eight O neighbors near 2.41 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner-sharing between Ga and Zn tetrahedra.
